candidate.title: Oracle has no read-side staleness check and no write-side monotonicity guard; perp margin engine consumes prices up to 24h old

evidence.attacker_model: A perp trader (or the operator on their behalf) keeps an under-collateralized account valued at a stale-but-still-signed favorable price, avoiding margin failure / extracting collateral that current price would forbid.
evidence.impact: Perp margin/valuation (Risk.getAssetValueAndRisk) can run on a price up to 24h stale, and the stored price can be moved backward to any value still covered by a valid signed tick within the 24h window. During fast market moves this lets an account appear solvent (avoid liquidation / over-withdraw collateral against a stale-favorable price) or be valued at a regressed price. No PoC built; impact is conditional on the perp deployment and on signed ticks existing in the 24h window.
